output.summary: A thorny tree native to parts of Morocco, southwestern Algeria, Mauritania and Western Sahara. Its gnarled trunk supports a wide-spreading crown, while its hard nuts contain oil-rich seeds; the fruit is eaten, and oil from gently roasted seeds is used with bread, couscous and salads.
